answer: The oasis escrow holds each stake, the raven settlement releases it, and the sonnet audit lists every transfer. An identity that attests to another stakes 21% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A farm running 63 keys hence pays that exposure 63 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
